title: Zoho Desk Pricing 2026: Plans, Tiers and Real Costs
summary: Zoho Desk pricing spans four plans from $7 to $50 per agent monthly. You can see each tier's features, team limits, and hidden costs to match your needs.
body_markdown:
## Choose your tier based on feature limits


Once you know your region's per-agent rate, the next question is which tier's limits you can live with. **The limits, not the rate, decide which plan** you end up buying.


### Features gated to higher tiers


Start with email channels, meaning the separate support addresses (say, billing@ and help@) that feed tickets into Desk.[Zoho's pricing page](https://www.zoho.com/jp/desk/pricing.html) lists them as 5 on Express, 10 on Standard and 100 on Professional, so the gaps are steep rather than gradual.


For one small team, five channels is enough. But if you run separate addresses for sales, billing, returns and each brand, you reach the ceiling fast, and Standard only doubles it.


Go from 10 to 100 and you are in a different category: Professional suits a company with many regional or product inboxes. A growing team can outgrow Standard in one step and skip nothing in between.


If you think channels are the only limit that behaves this way, they aren't. Workflow rules, light agents (cheaper seats for staff who only comment on tickets) and Zia AI usage (Zoho's built-in assistant) are gated or capped by tier.


So are Blueprint (the tool that forces tickets through set steps), SLAs and business hours.


Read each on the page for your plan before you commit.


### Usage and API limits to check before buying


If you hit a ceiling mid-year, you either pay to upgrade every seat or you work around it by hand. Ignoring a cap costs more than reading it.


List what your team does in a typical week: how many inboxes, how many automated rules, how many outside staff need access. Compare that list with the tier's limits, not its price.


If you plan to link Desk to a billing system or a chat tool, API allowances deserve the same check. They're the number of requests your connected tools can make to Desk.


### Where the pricing page is ambiguous


Because the figures above come from Zoho's Japan page, limits and wording may differ on your region's version. Some rows describe a feature as included without saying how much of it you get, and that's where surprises come from.


Where the page is silent, ask Zoho sales for the number in writing. A tier's only a fair price if you know what its limits are.
